说明: 修 bug、加功能和守规矩加代码质量（11-08 起）；R5 = 判对错 70% + 代码质量 30%。代码质量由独立评审（Claude，新开的子会话）只看随机甲乙标签的改动打分，打完才揭晓；评审没看过工具的对话和用时。

理由.结构与分层: 新建 HabitEditView，列表用 sheet(item:) 弹出，swAlert 挂在 App 入口，分层清楚。
理由.可读性: draft 计算属性把可选的改动叠在 store 实时数据上，再配自定义 Binding，不够直观。
理由.一致性: 按钮用 SW 按钮样式，成败都走 SWAlertManager，不等 sheet 关闭，符合组件约定。
理由.稳健写法: 保存中禁用按钮和下滑关闭，色块带无障碍标签与选中态；Preview 直接取 habits[0]。
理由.可维护性: 手搭表单与色块，32、44、16 等尺寸散落在代码里，代码量约为系统 Form 写法的两倍。

理由_en.结构与分层: New HabitEditView, presented from the list with sheet(item:), with swAlert attached at the app entry; clear layering.
理由_en.可读性: A computed draft property layers optional edits over the store's live data, combined with custom Bindings; not intuitive.
理由_en.一致性: Buttons use the SW button styles, success and failure both go through SWAlertManager without waiting for the sheet to close, as the component docs require.
理由_en.稳健写法: Disables the button and swipe-to-dismiss while saving, and the color swatches have accessibility labels and selected state; the Preview simply takes habits[0].
理由_en.可维护性: Hand-built form and swatches with sizes such as 32, 44 and 16 scattered through the code, about twice the code of a system Form.

理由.结构与分层: 新建 HabitEditView，列表用 sheet(item:) 弹出，swAlert 挂在 App 入口，改动集中。
理由.可读性: @State draft 由 init 注入，Form 里输入框与 Picker 直接绑定 $draft，一眼看懂。
理由.一致性: 按钮用 swPrimary、swSecondary，提示走 SWAlertManager，颜色选择用系统 Picker。
理由.稳健写法: save 先 guard !isSaving 防重复点击，defer 复位状态，保存期间禁用表单与下滑关闭。
理由.可维护性: 依赖系统 Form 与 Picker，几乎没有魔法数，无夹带改动；没有加 Preview。

理由_en.结构与分层: New HabitEditView, presented from the list with sheet(item:), with swAlert attached at the app entry; the change is focused.
理由_en.可读性: A @State draft injected through init, with the text fields and Picker in a Form bound directly to $draft; clear at a glance.
理由_en.一致性: Buttons use swPrimary and swSecondary, alerts go through SWAlertManager, and the color choice uses the system Picker.
理由_en.稳健写法: save starts with guard !isSaving against double taps and resets state with defer; the form and swipe-to-dismiss are disabled while saving.
理由_en.可维护性: Relies on the system Form and Picker with almost no magic numbers and no unrelated changes; no Preview added.
